description.value: Spinnakers Guesthouses sit on the grounds of Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub, Canada's first licensed in-house brewpub, which has been operating since 1984 in Victoria's Vic West neighbourhood. The accommodation offers Heritage Houses, Garden Suites, and a Bungalow steps from the waterfront sea walk along Lime Bay, with check-in handled through the on-site Provisions Store. Guests have immediate access to a full-service brewpub restaurant and a provisions shop stocked with baked goods, bottled beer, and local treats.

The on-site brewpub is confirmed to serve dinner, making nearby evening food verifiable from the website's own content.
